title: promote-lights draws its band and can watch any PR
description: Shows the CI checks of a pull request as a row of colored lights right above where you type, so you see red before you ask to merge. The band is built from $.ui.resolve(e) elements. /lights watch owner/repo#N or PROMOTE_LIGHTS_WATCH tracks any open PR in any repo. session.start clears stale lights before the first tick.
